# [AQUA-E]{.acronym-literal}: Authenticator Employment QM {#authenticator-employment-quality-model}

::: {.model-intro .employment}
**[AQUA-E]{.acronym-literal}** has the same quality factors and subfactors as [**[AQUA-A]{.acronym-literal}**](#authenticator-quality-model). The difference lies only in their definitions, which are documented in the [**Description**](#employment-table).
:::
